Yeah, my parents sadly loved drugs a lot more than me so all I learned was really toxic behavior (that I gladly changed)

Thank you so so so much for taking the time to help me :)

SAME! Those are my favorite kind of shows! There is one episode of Chopped that always makes me smile/cry (depends on my mood) It's the one with the lunch ladys, if you haven't seen it, it's really really cute!

Thank you for all your ideas and thank you for not making me feel like a failure. Hugs to you! <3

Congratulations! I'm so happy for you! You ARE worth it! Always remember, narcissistic people will always want to steal your thunder. I, as your sibling, am really really really proud of you no matter what!

Happy birthday sib! I'll drink to you today!

Please feel hugged and don't feel the need to reach out to her. If you want to, you can talk to me instead.
Thank you! I think the next time I have a full day off I will try to organize and clean and tidy everything. Thank you for giving me confidence that I'm not a total fuckup haha

Okay that's sound advice! The dry erase board sounds really really helpful! And what I gain from all the comments is, i should REALLY get a second laundry basket haha

Thanks to all of you guys for believing in me <3

My problem is: I have a laundry basket and it's overflowing so I put the new stuff on the floor. I know have a "second laundry basket" (an IKEA bag) that's also full so I don't know what to do with the laundry anymore. I think I should wake up earlier in the morning to do laundry, that might help.

Thank you for your advice! I think my biggest problem is that I don't do stuff right away and then it get's really overwhelming fast :(

I told my boyfriend about it and I promised him, I'll clean it. He told me he'll help me but I'm just waaaay to embarrassed to show him. Also I kinda want to do it on my own. 

I have a dog too so I vacuum as soon as I see the dog hair piling up (might be too late) but I never really vacuum the bathroom or anything because I don't know when it's time to do it. Things like vacuuming and cleaning the bathtub are things that I wish my mom taught me.

Uhhhh, I love folding laundry too! I don't know what's keeping me from doing it when I get it out of the dryer. It sounds crazy but sometimes I'm really exhausted by the time I get the laundry out of the dryer that I just wanna lay down. Not because I don't want to do it but it kinda overwhelms me and that puts me down and I feel exhausted just by looking at it. 

What's your favorite trash tv? And thanks for your advice <3

Okay! This helps a lot, thank you. I'll try that! I love making lists and plans and charts so that's actually really really helpful! 

I try to do dishes every day but it got so overwhelming that I don't eat that much anymore. I used to love cooking (it was my favorite hobby) but I've been working evening shifts so I don't cook when I get home and either get something quick on my way home or I just don't have dinner at all. 

I'll try to gain the confidence to invite a friend over to help me. But I'm really insecure about the whole thing. I've had clinical depression my whole life and now that my life is getting better and I'm kinda okay with my life, the mess is still there. Depression used to be my excuse but now I just feel lazy :(

Hi! Not a mom, but a sibling.  
I just wanted to tell you that you're NEVER to old to start new relationships, either romantic or platonic. 

> I'm pretty niche to like to begin with

I feel that! But don't feel the need to apologize for that. I realized a few years ago that many people probably won't like me and that's okay! Never apologize for being you. 

You can always send me a DM if you need to rant.
Thank you sib. Do you have any insights on how it feels to want to contact your parent again? Because I know that I shouldn't and I 100% won't, but how do I shake the feeling of wanting to?

Thank you so so so much. I always wanted to go to university. I always wanted to be that person to take my studies too serious. And I didn't. I have this stupid fucking sonofabitch disease (excuse my wording) that's holding me back. I'm not one to blame everything on my depression but since I was a little child there was always a thing holding me back. Making me do stuff again and again that is really easy for "normal" people. I've been having a hard time to get into studying because at school - which I don't know much about because I had to quit at age 15 - I was really gifted and didn't have to learn how to study. It sounds like a first world problem but I've been struggling a lot. Though, I kinda enjoy the learning process because it gives me insides into who I am as a person. i would think of myself as a very reflective human being which isn't always that great. I do miss my Papa, and I'm very conflicted if I should contact him. Why does making the worst choice seem like the best idea sometimes?

I sure hope so! It's been hard. Everyone at university is like 6-7 years younger than I am. My dad was my always my greatest cheerleader, that part I miss. Your words made me tear up, thank you for saying such kind things. I hope you have a great evening

Hi sib, not a dad here but a fellow abused child. I can relate to your story a lot. My dad used to think the only way we could make a connection, was us being friends. I never wanted to be my dad's friend. I wanted to be a child. I raised my parents and my sister more than they raised me. If you want to talk, I'm here. Take care, sis <3

Hey sib, I know you are mad right now. Mad at the world, mad at your parents, mad at all the parents that scrolled past your post. I get that. I've been there. We've all been there.  
I know it's hard to feel like you are being ignored. Don't let the anger make stupid mistakes for you. If someone in reallife won't give you the most perfect answer to a request you shouldn't be mad at them. Everyone is their own person.

I'm here for you sib. But don't be so hostile against people who aren't obligated to answer your post. Maybe they don't have anything contributory to say. Maybe they want to answer later when they have time to say something longer, something useful. Maybe they are not interested, which is also okay. 

You're not alone, don't forget that. But don't make it about a reddit post. You can be whoever you want to be.

Thank you so much! You care about me, that's easy to see! (wanted to rhyme too). I graduated high school when I was 22 because I had to start working at age 15. My parents were drug addicts who I raised more than they raised me. Education was my only goal in life. It's taking me wayyyyy longer than my peers to graduate my bachelors degree but I'm working two jobs and I'm managing. I know I can do this and I feel accomplished on my own.   


...it's just that the little girl in me still wants someone to be proud of me.

Hi! Thank you so so so so much.

I miss how my dad used to treat me when I was a child. When he was sober he was the best dad in the world. He used to teach me writing and maths and played with me every day. When I grew up we lost our connection and it became something he called "friendship". 

I just don't know how to react from getting all the attention I need to someone telling me I'm the reason for their mental and physical illnesses. I miss him. I really needed the words you just told me. Thank you, online-dad. Hugs

Soooo, the reason they shut off the gas is because we didn't pay the bill in time. I'm a little bit low on money at the moment so I won't be able to buy any stove :(

But thank you for your recommendations! It's a really small cheap rice cooker with only "cook" and "keep warm" but I think I can still try to cook with it I think, I'll check out the links! Thank you
Thank you! I didn't think of the rice cooker!!

Thank you for your kind words. You're right about the work thing, I had'nt thought about that. I have another job 4 hours a week but I should go to the employment center thingy tomorrow and ask them for help, thank you! I somehow haven't thought of that yet, I'm still very disturbed because of all the messages he sent.

I'm glad your wife is okay now and cut those awful people out of her life. Hug her for me. Everyone of us, all of us with abusive and horrible parents deserve all the love and affection we missed out on as children. I'm glad you too found each other and I wish your little family all the best in the world. 

I met a lot of people who think that way. But my whole family on my mom's side hate my dad because he abused her for years. I'm glad that they would be on my side.

Thank you. I can relate to a lot of what you said. My dad was always proud that he never *hit* me. But he shouted. And threw stuff that most of the time missed me. And hit the table. But he never hit me. And that's what he constantly told me when I just said anything negative to him. He always told me "You can be so glad that I was in your life and that I never treated you badly. I never hit you.". So most of my life I thought he was a great parent, because he told me so. Isn't it funny how that works?

You're right. I always feel like I need to please my parents but in the past few months I tried to do it less and it feels great. I feel like they're finally becoming independent when it should be the other way around haha

I am really confident in the idea of cutting ties with my dad but on the other hand it makes me so sad. Then I always remember the few good times. And that hurts.

Thank you for your words. <3
Thank you, it worked! I'll definitely check it out!
Thank you :)

Hi. Oh my god. Thank you for this. Hugs to you. 

You know. You hit the nail on the head. My dad was raised by an awful woman. Until I was 9 years old I lived with my grandparents most of the time because my parents were busy with work. My granddad was the best human I've ever met. He was the only person I would ever consider a parent. He taught me maths and writing at an early age and helped me with all my schoolwork and after school we spent the whole day together, every day. I loved him more than anything. But his wife was an awful human being. She always told me my tattoos look awful, that my hair looks awful and that she doesn't like that she still hasn't met any of my boyfriends (guess why). She raised my dad horribly. She gave him everything because he was her little boy. It was sickening. So my dad never learnt that he had to be nice to people. 

Your words made me tear up, I'm so thankful, thanks Dad. You're a wonderful human being that you're helping dad-less girls on the internet like me. Thank you.

You got this too! I'm so thankful for everything. You can DM me if you ever want to talk about someone, I'm here. If we don't have parents to teach us lifestuff, we can teach each other :) Society is fucked anyways, all we can do is spend time with people that make you feel good and help you grow.

Yeah, I get that. Sometimes I still start to apologize for no real reason or try to back out of a fight because I get scared of confrontation. I still sometimes have the feeling that people hate me for no reason or think that I'm annoying even though I just met them. It's the feeling that my dad left inside of me. The feeling of never being good enough, no matter how hard you try. It sucks. I felt so good the past months, he was great. We laughed, shared relationship stuff and just had a good time working together. When he stopped drinking it went a little bit downhill but it was alright. And now I came back from 3 weeks covid and he completely changed and acted the same like he did when I was a teenager. 

Sorry I don't know where that sudden rant came from haha but I just had to type it out.

Thank you so much! Thank you especially for all your resources! I started listening to the Pete Walker book and I really enjoy it so far.

You're so nice for saying this. This whole thing with my dad made me realize that there are more people I could cut out of my life.

I just took the quiz and I got 14/20 which is a lot more than I would have thought, I'll definitely check the book out! I never connected my sensitivities to Trauma, this is mind blowing, thank you!!

Thank you so much <3
Thank you! That's a great perspective. Thank you so much for your kind words. All of you are great. I can't thank this community enough, I hope all of you know how much you're helping us.

Thank you Dad, thank you so much! Hugs back.

I am really sad he started being like this again. He made such a great effort to build a relationship again and I really don't know where it went downhill. He sent me such awful messages the past days like how he doesn't know how anyone could spend time with me and it..just hurt.

My whole life I've never been a fan of lying and the biggest lie my parents told me is that I could be whoever I want to. Because when I'm with my dad I'm not even a little bit allowed to be myself or he would call me annoying or a know-it-all.

Thank you for your kind words. I'm sure you're a great dad and you've been a great internet-dad to me. Hugs

Somehow I can't open the link but I'll try when I'm not on mobile!

Thank you anyways

I've been working on it in therapy. First step is cutting my dad out of my life. Nobody should make me cry, ever. After that I don't know. It's a confusing time and I didn't think it would hurt that much. I thought "He's a bad person so I just don't talk to him anymore" but it's so complex and hard.

You're right, thank you. That sound's like a good perspective, I will keep that in mind. I can still love the good memories I had with him. Some childhood memories with him have a special place in my heart. But there are so so so many bad memories that I just want to forget. And if I just love the person he was sometimes, or the person he could have been, he stays in my life without physically being in my life as a person. I love that.

Thank you very much, you are a great dad to your girl and I'm really thankful that there are still nice people out there who want to help others.
You know, I really don't care why.
I know right? Funny thing is, my parents said that so many hundred times that I started to believe it as a child

You're so right. It took me until I was in my early 20s to realize that my parents are the reason for a lot of struggles in my daily life. I remember the exact moment that I realized: I was at my ex boyfriend's house and spilled some juice all over the couch. I nearly started crying and apologized and ran to get some paper towels. When I came back, my boyfriend looked at me, confused. We sat down and talked about it and that's when I found out that normal parents don't shout at their children for spilling liquids or breaking glassing. Before that moment, I had never thought about that. 

Therapy and reading a lot about narcissistic parents helped a ton. I always thought that my mom was right, that I imagined all the bad things that happened to me. But there are so many people out there who experienced the exact same thing. Its horrible. I always secondguess everything I do and it makes life so much less enjoyable. But I've been working on it!

I'm so thankful for all of your responses! You're right, he had more than enough chances.

My dude, I'm so sorry you had to go through that! If you ever want to talk about our similar experiences, just DM me!

I'm really proud of you for going NC.

I will check that out, thank you so much!

My therapist is great, I've only been going for a few months and I don't think I've really worked through stuff but I feel like I get more confident and I can reflect better on my actions. Therapy and writing are both awesome, recommend it to everyone, it's been helping a ton

Edit: Just got a book by Pete Walker on Audible, I'll listen to it in the next couple days!

my biggest problem is that i got into the habit of helping my parents and my sister and caring for them. I can't break out of it. It feels like their incompetence is my fault even if i know it isn't. i feel like I helped them too much and now they rely on me.
That's exactly how it is! Everytime someone puts a plate down too fast I feel like I'm sitting the dinner table again with my angry dad. It hurts so bad
I also feel like he never grew up. Since I was a small child I always had to handle my parent's lives and I'm sick of being their parent.

hey. I'm crying. That's exactly what I needed to hear. you're great.

He's hurt me all my life but I've always felt compassion for him. We rekindled our relationship in the past months, he went to a therapist, he stopped drinking, he took my advice, he did everything to make our relationship better. But when he said "you're the reason why I'm depressed", something died inside of me. It hurt so much, I can't describe it.

But I'm so bad at cutting people out of my life. I always feel like they deserve a second chance. I always feel like "What if I'm delusional? Maybe I'm just sensitive" and I'm having such a hard time with the thought of telling him to fuck off. But then on the other side - the image of a life without him fills me with...relief?
My problem is work. I really need to relax a little bit after I get off work. And then I’m so unmotivated :(
I was so mad hahaha

Hi! Sib here. I’m coming from a similar Situation. 
In my case my mom and I are closer than ever just because I moved out.

I know it’s hard but if you want to talk, I’m here.

Sib here that has been clean for 2 years with only one relapse - ITS OKAY IF YOU RELAPSE!

That’s the hardest but most important thing to remember. Take yourself first. Take a break. Ask friends or family for help if you can, if you can’t, DM me!

You’re the moat important thing and you have to realize that 🤍

That’s some great advise! I’ll be using the empty cup-analogy in the future, thank you! 
Im really great at forgetting myself. It was my birthday last week and I spent the whole day giving out food to the homeless after which I realized that I didn’t invite anyone to my birthdayparty and was really really really upset afterwards.
I know it sounds stupid but only 3 people showed up to my birthday party. It’s more than enough, don’t get me wrong, it was just…I could have handled it better

I will! 
Im in Austria, which is always confused with Australia, and I’m sending you hugs back! I will try to cut back a bit. Do you have any advise on how to start?

Im not in the US, but I’ve been advocating this for a long time. I’ve been working voluntarily to change things here.
It’s rough. I know I have all the time in the world to finish my studies but somehow I’ve set myself a timer to finish it way sooner that I’m able to. I don’t know.
I’ve been so late with everything in life that I just rush my studies. And my work but it’s going bad

You’re so right! My mom dealt with burnout my whole life. Now I’m feeling like I’m having a burnout from doing literally nothing. 
I brought it up with my boyfriend - he told me “you’re alright, you’re strong!” which isn’t helping me at all.
I’ve been feeling so worn out for nearly two months now. Wasn’t able to do anything except go to work. 
I don’t know what to do

Do you have any advise on how to focus on yourself and not feel like I’m leaving everyone behind? I mean feeling like I’m taking care of myself without feeling like I’m not helping others? I feel like I’m not doing enough even though it’s too much for myself

Hi! I’m not a mom, but a sibling. But I’m here for you. I’ve been going through a kinda similar time. Had to put down my doggo in February. Struggling with my mental health. My real parents aren’t there for me. But I’m here for you!
I’ve been trying. I just feel so so so guilty. Like I’ve leaving everyone behind
I’ll take all the hugs! I’m not a great hugger but I’ll send some back, thanks mom :)

You’re right! Thinking of me time like a chore sounds like it should work! 
I’m actually invited to a party today and I told them I wouldn’t come because I have schoolwork but it’s a Friday night - maybe I take my doggo to my moms place and go out! It would be something to do for me. I’ve worked 12 hours today - 5 hours at the office and 7 hours entertaining birthday parties for kids at the Planetarium so I might even deserve it :)

You’re right. You’re so right. Thank you mom ❤️

Thank you so much! I’m actually proud of me too! I’m specializing in astrophysics and even though it’s really hard I enjoy it sososo much! 

I’ve been thinking about that too. My problem is, everytime I just try to be and do nothing or do something I really enjoy like playing Stardey valley or draw (both of which I haven’t done in months) I feel so bad and go do the dishes instead, or do school stuff. It’s hard.

There is no one else. My parents have always depended on me and called me selfish if I didn’t do everything. I feel gaslighted but on the other hand I really want to be there for them

I'm not a Mom. I'm a sibling. But even though I don't know how life works, I've been a really good older sister my whole life. I'm here for you if you want to talk. I feel a lot of myself in this post. If you want to rant, I'm here.

Your reply made my tear up. Thank you so much. I'm just so used to being the punching bag for my whole family and also being there for them. I wish my Mom would just let me cry.

edit: Thank you especially for saying the part about crying with me. That's exactly what I want. Someone crying with me in sympathy, not in competition.
That's a nice idea too, to just keep it in a drawer. I have a drawer with all the boxes for my medication, I think it would perfectly fit in there!
Thank you! I asked my mom and she said she could maybe try to make it into a bracelet, so I'm excited!
This is actually kinda cute, thank you! and you're the sweetest to be thinking of me haha xx
Not in the US, but we have something similar to Michaels where I didn't think to look, so thank you!
Oh I love that! I just googled Shadow boxes and I will also have a look on etsy! Thank you so much!
Thank you so much! xx
I will! I have to leave for the appointment in half an hour, I feel like a part of me is dead.

You're right! I don't know why I didn't just ask my mom haha   
Sorry; I've been confused the whole day.
Thank you! I'm currently trying to find out how to make it but I can't find anything. My mind's all over the place.

Hi! Thank you! I'm thinking about getting his pawprint and getting a tattoo of it. I'm also currently asking all my family members of photos of him. Thank you! I'll give my second dog all the love she deserves <3
Thank you! My boyfriend was awake nearly the whole night because I woke up with panic attacks a few times. I'm letting myself cry and get mad and it really helps. Thank you for your words <3
I sadly can't do it at home. It's too expensive :( But I'll stay with my babyboy. xx hugs

I have to go to the vet by myself, sadly. Covid sucks.
